source.name: Steadfast
source.originalDescription: If at 50% max HP or below: grants this Pokémon a shield and increases their movement speed by 20% for 5s (45s CD). While at low HP, gain a shield and increased movement speed. (30s cooldown)
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Steadfast は シールドを付与する、HP割合条件で発動する。

source.name: Attack
source.originalDescription: Becomes a boosted attack with increased range every third attack, hitting twice. The first hit damages opposing Pokémon with a normal basic attack; the second hit is a follow-up attack with a bone, damaging opposing Pokémon in the area a second time and throwing them for 0.5s. Becomes a boosted attack with every third attack, performing a combo attack with a bone. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect and throws them.

source.name: Aura Cannon
source.originalDescription: Becomes unstoppable for 0.6s and channels aura into a huge sphere, then launches the sphere in the designated direction, dealing damage to opposing Pokémon in its path. The aura sphere picks up speed as it travels; at close range, a target can be hit up to 4 times, while at max speed a target will only be hit once. If the user learned Extreme Speed: applies an Extreme Speed marker to targets hit by this Unite Move. If the user learned Power-Up Punch: strengthens the damage of the next attack of Power-Up Punch by roughly 20% and the shove duration to 1s when Power-Up Punch is released. Deals damage to enemies in the area of effect. Increases the damage dealt by the user's next Power-Up Punch after using this move. Buffs: 30% Movement Speed, 30% CDR, 20% Max HP Shield
source.translatedDescription: 機械要約: Aura Cannon は 相手を押し出す、妨害無効になる、与ダメージを変化させる、待ち時間を短縮する、シールドを付与する、スタック、マーク、ゲージを扱う。
